data.name: MindMapDescription
data.value: An interactive mind map with its action bar and node properties panel, read-only mode, directed links and stored format, then a commit graph.

data.name: MindMapSettingsDescription
data.value: The map keeps its changes while you switch the settings.

data.name: MindMapReadOnlyDescription
data.value: Nodes can be selected, the map panned and zoomed, but nothing changes.

data.name: MindMapDirectedDescription
data.value: Each link starts at the edge of a node and ends with an arrow on the edge of the other.

data.name: MindMapShowPanelDescription
data.value: Text, colour, size and style of the selected node.

data.name: MindMapCustomLabelsDescription
data.value: The page renames three actions; the others keep the component's texts.

data.name: MindMapShowJsonDescription
data.value: Shows the JSON the page would store.

data.name: MindMapActionsDescription
data.value: Fit the view again, or go back to the sample map.

data.name: MindMapKeyboardHint
data.value: Keyboard: arrows to move between nodes, N for a new node, F2 to rename, Delete to remove, Ctrl+Z to undo.
